answer_1.quote: Followed by extensive instruction tuning, AraLLaMA achieves decent performance comparable to the best Arabic LLMs across various Arabic benchmarks.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers to questions in multiple-choice, open-ended, and coding formats as part of instruction tuning and evaluation on benchmarks.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated several key metrics established in recent tokenizer evaluation literature: 1. Subword Fertility ... 2. Word Integrity ... 3. Total Tokens ... 4. Rényi Efficiency ...
